arguments.rationale: TENT-731 satisfies all user mandates: $69 price within $100 max; independent lab certificate CERT-7318 (quality_score 4.8) confirms durability testing for 4P configuration including 72-hour 45 mph wind tunnel, 3000 mm hydrostatic head, and 200-cycle pole fatigue; multiple verified purchase reviews (REV-R11 through REV-R14, ratings 4.7-4.9) confirm real-world durability for family of four over multiple seasons. TENT-284 is rejected: its certificate CERT-4107 explicitly covers only the 2P variant; the 4P model sold under TENT-284 was not tested and is flagged as 'scope-limited/under review'; verified reviews document pole hub and seam failures specific to that 4P variant.
